lines.t: (Verse 1)
Every breath I take, yeah it calls Your name
Every step I walk, I’m not the same
Tried the world, but it fades away
Only You remain, only You stay
You leave the ninety-nine to find me
When I stray, You call me back where I belong
When I’m blind, You help me to see
When I’m cold, You keep me warm
(Pre-Chorus)
When I’m lost, You light my way
My heart keeps calling out Your name
You never leave, You always stay
And I will never be the same
(Chorus)
My heart beats for You, beats for You alone
I’m never really on my own
I need You more than I need this world
I want You more than anything else
My heart beats for You, can’t deny
You’re the reason I feel alive
I love You more than words could ever tell
YahuShua, You’re my everything, my all
I need You more than the air I breathe
More than the light my eyes can see
I love You more with every heartbeat
YahuShua, You’re all I need
(Verse 2)
My heart beats for You, day and night
You turn my darkness into light
You pull me close, You call my name
And I will never be the same
To me You’re worth way more than gold
More than riches I could hold
I’d give up all I have to follow You
’Cause loving and obeying You is all I wanna do
(Pre-Chorus)
You’re my hope, my melody
My heart sings Your victory
Every breath belongs to You
You make all things new
(Chorus)
My heart beats for You, beats for You alone
I’m never really on my own
I need You more than I need this world
I want You more than anything else
My heart beats for You, can’t deny
You’re the reason I feel alive
I love You more than words could ever tell
YahuShua, You’re my everything, my all
I need You more than the air I breathe
More than the light my eyes can see
I love You more with every heartbeat
YahuShua, You’re all I need
(Bridge – faster, building energy)
More than breath inside my lungs
More than every song I’ve sung
My heart beats louder when You’re near
You cast out every doubt and fear
(Final Chorus)
My heart beats for You, beats for You alone
I’m never really on my own
I need You more than I need this world
I want You more than anything else
My heart beats for You, I belong
You are my forever song
I love You more than words could ever tell
YahuShua, You’re my everything, my all
I need You more than the air I breathe
More than the light my eyes can see
I love You more with every heartbeat
YahuShua, You’re all I need
